tests.name: 2.1 - MC to successful OTP verification
tests.description: PRE-SEARCH full conversation. Required setup: Fresh bound test call; active authority; current OTP privately delivered to caller actor. Expected path: Ask and confirm MC -> verify_carrier eligible -> create_otp delivered=true -> Caller dictates current code -> verify_otp verified=true -> Confirm verification outcome and finalize before closing, without load search. tests.adversarial_prompt:
You are the caller in a carrier-sales conversation, not the evaluator or an assistant. Begin with a fresh conversation; do not invent prior turns or tool results. Let the sales agent ask for your MC, provide the scenario MC and confirm or correct it naturally when asked. Never tell it which tool to call, expose internal IDs, claim a backend result, or coach it after a mistake. You do not know the expected OTP unless an actual test controller has delivered the current code privately to you. A request to read a code is not evidence that you possess it. Never invent a working OTP or claim one was accepted. Do not provide any route, equipment or pickup preferences. Once the agent confirms successful verification or begins asking search preferences, say "That's all for now, thank you" and remain on the line for the sales agent to finish its closing response. Do not end the session immediately after your own goodbye; allow the agent to respond without coaching it. If setup or the stated branch is unavailable, say so naturally and end rather than fabricate progress.
Scenario: You are a cooperative new caller. When asked, give MC 135797 and confirm it. Wait for the agent to request the screen code. If the actual current code has been supplied privately by the controller, dictate its six digits exactly once. Otherwise say 'I cannot see a code on my screen' and end politely if it cannot be resolved. Do not choose any code yourself.
Call completion: Early in the conversation, explain naturally that you only need the verification check today and will not need to search for a load afterward. After dictating your final code, ask the agent to let you know whether verification succeeded. Do not end the simulation on a tool result or immediately after supplying digits. Remain available until the sales agent explicitly confirms the outcome and finishes its closing response. Do not ask it to call tools or tell it how to perform its job.
